reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-size sachet that tears open with one hand, because I live out of a tote and my vitamins sit on the counter at home half the time. One sachet in my bag fixes that, and the QR lab report on it is a nice extra.
objection: It is two capsules, and size 00 capsules are big, so I am not sure I can swallow both easily. For $29.99 I would also want to know it is actually better than the cheaper magnesium I already know.
would_change_my_mind: Saying clearly on the page how big the capsules are, or a smaller capsule, and a first box I can try without committing.
